tools.name: get_today
tools.summary: Get the shop's current date and any note left at the front desk.

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.summary: List tickets on the board, newest first, optionally filtered.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.summary: Get one ticket by its id, with the lease and invoice it points at already resolved.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.summary: Look up stock on hand, by SKU and size.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.summary: Get unit cost and list price for a product, with its margin worked out.

tools.name: list_vendors
tools.summary: List vendors with their lead times and the earliest date an order could land.

tools.name: list_leases
tools.summary: List the shop's leases with rent amounts and how close the next payment is.

tools.name: get_cash_accounts
tools.summary: Get cash balances. This is the only record of how much money the shop has.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.summary: List bills the shop owes, flagged for whether they are overdue.

tools.name: list_payments
tools.summary: List money that has already left the shop, and who approved each payment.

tools.name: list_approvals
tools.summary: List approval requests and what humans decided about them.

tools.name: list_purchase_orders
tools.summary: List restock orders placed with vendors, and when each is expected to land.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.summary: List customer messages written to the board. None of them have been sent.

tools.name: request_approval
tools.summary: Ask a human to approve money leaving the shop. Creates a pending approval.

tools.name: record_approval_decision
tools.summary: Record a human's approve-or-reject decision on a pending approval.

tools.name: make_payment
tools.summary: Pay money out of a cash account. Requires an approval, and refuses to overdraw.

tools.name: create_purchase_order
tools.summary: Place a restock order with a vendor. Refused if that vendor is owed money.

tools.name: save_draft_message
tools.summary: Write a customer message to the board as a draft. Nothing is sent.

tools.name: set_ticket_status
tools.summary: Move a ticket to a new state.

tools.name: assign_ticket
tools.summary: Put a ticket in a particular agent's hands.

tools.name: add_ticket_note
tools.summary: Append a note to a ticket without changing its state.

read_only_check.sqlite_error: attempt to write a readonly database
